title: Six-Block Executable Capability Experiments
purpose: Test six distinct executable cognitive blocks with separate observables, equal-budget sham controls, and anti-alias checks before scaling to 36 deterministic jobs.

B1_representation_world_model.mechanism: infer a compact latent predictive model from observations and choose a representation that minimizes heldout prediction error
B1_representation_world_model.sham_control: same compute over randomly permuted candidate representations

B2_reasoning_creativity.mechanism: derive valid conclusions from rule sets and generate candidate solution paths under structural novelty constraints
B2_reasoning_creativity.sham_control: same number of candidate derivations with rule-order permutation only

B3_planning_experimentation.mechanism: select an action sequence and next experiment to reduce uncertainty under a fixed action budget
B3_planning_experimentation.sham_control: same action count with random experiment selection

B4_verification_metacognition.mechanism: detect invalid candidates, calibrate confidence, and abstain only when uncertainty is justified
B4_verification_metacognition.sham_control: same verification calls with confidence labels shuffled

B5_learning_transfer.mechanism: update strategy from verified prior failures and transfer reusable structure to an unseen task family
B5_learning_transfer.sham_control: same update budget with failure labels permuted

B6_cooperation_self_improvement.mechanism: combine independent partial proposals, detect disagreement, and apply a bounded procedure revision validated on development tasks
B6_cooperation_self_improvement.sham_control: same proposal and revision count but random proposal fusion

anti_alias_rules: No two blocks may share the same primary metric and same decision variable set.
Each block must expose a unique state transition or observable intervention.
A block fails if replacing it with another block's computation leaves outputs unchanged on all test cases.
Sham control receives equal deterministic compute budget.
No hidden target values, family labels, or latent generator parameters may be visible to selectors.
scale_rule: Do not launch the 36 deterministic jobs until all six block-level executable tests run successfully and anti-alias checks pass.
claim_limit: Passing BENCH-006 would establish only separable executable behavior in a synthetic test harness, not general intelligence, AGI, or superintelligence.
